item.description: A Vietnam-sponsored hacking group has been attributed to attacks targeting Southeast Asian military, government, and legislative organizations with an aim to gather intelligence on South China Sea defense and military agreements. item.title: Microsoft Store App Found Delivering Vinci RAT Capable of Remote System Control
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a cyber attack in which a threat actor leveraged a Microsoft Store application to deliver a remote access trojan (RAT) called Vinci RAT . The intrusion, according to eSentire, begins with a redirection to a bogus site for a sniping tool ("snipp.codes-team[.]com"), from where a Microsoft-signed installer called "Snipping-Tool.exe" is downloaded. Executing the binary leads to the installation of Setup Assistant , an Electron-based application published on the Microsoft Store by ETPS Ltd. "The application was heavily obfuscated, maintained communication with C2 [command-and-control] infrastructure, monitored the victim's Downloads folder, and supported execution of C2-supplied PowerShell and JavaScript," eSentire said . "This access was used to launch a malicious PowerShell stager, establish persistence through a scheduled task, and retrieve a previously undocumented PowerShell-based RAT....

item.title: How to Keep Your Security Picture Current When Attackers Move at AI Speed
item.description: Most security metrics are not built to be used. They are built to be shown. Somewhere between the quarterly review and the next status update, a set of numbers gets assembled that looks reassuring in a room and tells almost no one what is actually happening across the environment that week. Someone pulls them together the week before, cleans them up, and presents a picture of a program that is, as of that one morning, fine. This is not a failure of effort. Security teams are doing the work, often times more of it than anyone outside the team realizes. The problem is that the reporting cycle rewards the snapshot, and a snapshot is a memory, not a measurement. It tells you how things looked on the day you looked. It says very little about the weeks in between, and risk does not keep to a reporting schedule. item.title: Hackers Trojanize Official Q-Dir and DesktopOK Downloads to Deliver Remote Access Malware
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a software supply chain attack that has tampered with Q-Dir and DesktopOK installation files distributed via the official SoftwareOK website. "Evidence indicates that malicious files were generated not only when users downloaded the programs directly from the official download page but also during the update process of previously installed legitimate programs," South Korean cybersecurity company AhnLab said . Q-Dir, also called the Quad Directory Explorer, is a free, lightweight file manager for Windows developed by SoftwareOK. According to its website, DesktopOK is a free Windows utility designed to save and restore desktop icon positions. The unauthorized modifications are designed such that the malicious activity is challenging to detect when running the programs, while simultaneously retrieving and deploying a Python-based remote control malware (RAT) from an external server. item.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
item.description: Attackers using AI agents have broken into computer systems at Swiss organizations in four of five confirmed attacks, the first such cases in the country, the country's cybersecurity agency said yesterday. Three of the attacks targeted critical infrastructure operators, and two of those succeeded, with no major disruptions reported. The victims have not been named, and it is not known who is behind the attacks. Florian Schütz , who directs Switzerland's National Cyber Security Centre, gave the figures in an interview with public broadcaster SRF. All five cases were reported in recent days. Small and medium-sized companies were among the organizations hit, and they came forward voluntarily. The agency's first notice, a security advisory published on Tuesday, said the agents had compromised the victims' IT systems in every case known at that point. item.title: Unpatched Cacti Zero-Day Enables RCE in Just Four HTTP Requests via Guest Access
item.description: Details have emerged about a new zero-day vulnerability in Cacti , an open-source network monitoring tool, that could be exploited to achieve remote code execution. The proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit, which has yet to be assigned a CVE identifier, has been tracked as 4HTTP2SHELL and 4HTTP2ROOT . "I found a path from a fresh, unauthenticated HTTP session to command execution as the Cacti server user in four requests," a security researcher who goes by the online alias "ek0ms savi0r" said . "No login. No valid API key. No phishing. Just four HTTP requests against the default guest surface." The shortcoming affects Cacti Core 1.2.31, the latest version , when the guest account is enabled. It's worth noting that the guest account is disabled by default starting with Cacti version 0.8.7.
